metaDescription: Improved Emerald Rocket chinese cabbage: the chinese cabbage variety, with its traits, ratings and where it grows best in the Philippines.
keywords: Improved Emerald Rocket chinese cabbage variety
excerpt: Improved Emerald Rocket chinese cabbage is an F1 hybrid chinese cabbage variety, also sold or known as Improved Emerald Rocket F1 or Emerald Rocket. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Allied Botanical (Condor brand).

heroImage.alt: Vegetable terraces and plastic tunnels on the slopes of Mankayan, Benguet, the kind of farm where Improved Emerald Rocket chinese cabbage is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Improved Emerald Rocket F1 or Emerald Rocket, this is the same chinese cabbage. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [chinese cabbage variety finder](/crop-varieties/chinese-cabbage), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [vegetables in the Philippines](/crops/vegetables-philippines).
Key facts about Improved Emerald Rocket chinese cabbage

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

No day count or trial yield is published for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit chinese cabbage fields most often: [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [black rot of cabbage](/diseases/black-rot), [cabbage webworm](/pests/cabbage-webworm), [clubroot](/diseases/clubroot), [diamondback moth](/pests/diamondback-moth). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Fruit:** Head: michihili (tall) type with even heads and a good taste.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: a tall michihili type that its seller says is popular in Southern Mindanao. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant Improved Emerald Rocket chinese cabbage

Pechay Baguio heads best in cool places. In the lowlands, pick a heat tolerant hybrid and plant in the cool months. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.

items.q: Is Improved Emerald Rocket F1 the same as Improved Emerald Rocket?
items.a: Yes. Improved Emerald Rocket F1 is another name for Improved Emerald Rocket. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Improved Emerald Rocket?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
